unitTitle: B2 · Education, culture and identity: synthesize what people say
title: Listening practice
subtitle: B2 · Unit 8: B2 · Education, culture and identity: synthesize what people say

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: L'invitée a expliqué qu'elle avait repris ses études après plusieurs années. Elle a ajouté que les échanges du groupe l'avaient aidée à persévérer.
steps.question: What helped the guest persist?
steps.explain: She says the group's exchanges helped her continue.

steps.fr: Il dit que la lecture lui permet de découvrir d'autres perspectives. Il ne prétend pas que cette pratique suffit à elle seule.
steps.question: What limitation does the speaker make?
options: The speaker has never joined a group
Reading alone may not be sufficient
steps.explain: He explicitly says reading is not necessarily enough by itself.

steps.fr: La participante racontait qu'à l'époque, elle n'avait pas accès aux mêmes ressources qu'aujourd'hui.
steps.question: When did the participant lack access to those resources?
options: At the time she was describing
steps.explain: The imperfect and à l'époque refer to the period she is recounting.
